question: How many days of short leave can a UG student take on medical grounds?
answer:
A UG student can take a maximum of 10 days of short leave on medical grounds. 

[Source: regulations_web_2019_onwards.txt, p. 17]

question: How many grade points is an A- grade worth?
answer: An A- grade is worth 9 grade points. [Source: regulations_web_2019_onwards.txt, p. 7]

question: How many credits must a general category B.Tech student earn by the end of the second semester to continue in the program?
answer: A general category B.Tech student must earn a minimum of 80 credits by the end of the second semester to continue in the program. [Source: Academic Regulations (students enrolled from July 2020 onwards), p. 17]

question: What is the maximum number of credits I can register for in the summer term?
answer: The maximum number of credits a student can register for in the summer term is 16 for Executive (Accelerated) M.Tech. students, 9 for Executive (Normal) M.Tech. students, 6 for Executive (Slow-Paced) M.Tech. students, and 9 for Full-time (Regular) M.Tech. students. [Source: Rules and Regulations for PG Programmes (enrolled from July 2022 onwards), p. 21]

question: Is branch change allowed for B.Tech students admitted in 2026?
answer: Branch change is not allowed for B.Tech students admitted in 2026. According to the B.Tech Registration and Academic Session FAQ (branch change discontinued from AY 2026-27), "No Branch Change post second year onwards." [Source: B.Tech Registration and Academic Session FAQ (branch change discontinued from AY 2026-27), p. 2]
